notes: The per-file numbers sum higher than the total on purpose: what costs a session is all of them
together, and the per-file line is only there to stop one document eating the whole allowance.
The total is the real constraint and is a hard ceiling.
Raised deliberately on 2026-09-21, the whole set this time. The last raise moved src/CLAUDE.md
and left the total, which then sat at 96% and made the ceiling the thing every edit met instead.
Before raising it, the set was searched for fat two ways: a scanner for claims repeated between
two documents or lifted from a doc comment, and a per-section word count. It found 44 words of
restatement in 12 977 and no section that was over-written rather than dense - the vocabulary
table is one line per concept, and umbra's model section is twenty decisions of a paragraph each.
So the documents are not padded; the budgets were snapshots of a smaller day. Each file and the
total are set so today's content sits near 80%, which is working room rather than a target.
